mismatches.question: Is maternity treatment covered from day one of this policy?
mismatches.rationale: Maternity is subject to a 36-month waiting period; it is not covered until that period is served.

mismatches.question: Is there a deductible I must pay before the policy pays a claim?
mismatches.rationale: The policy states the deductible is Not Applicable, so no deductible amount is subtracted before cover applies.

mismatches.question: Will the policy pay for an ambulance to take me to hospital?
mismatches.rationale: Domestic Road Ambulance Cover is a granted benefit (cashless actuals / reimbursement up to Rs 10,000 or 1% SI), so ambulance transport is covered subject to that sub-limit.
